UBS Group third quarter 2026 report (Form 6-K, October 28, 2026), earnings per share and shares outstanding table

notes: One class of registered shares, listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange (UBSG.SW, CHF) and on the NYSE as global registered shares (UBS, USD); the 3Q26 report says the shares are listed on the NYSE 'as global registered shares', so the NYSE line is the same shares, not an ADR. The NYSE line, in US dollars (the reporting currency), is used. The count is shares issued minus treasury shares at September 30, 2026, from the 3Q26 report, because no document states shares outstanding excluding treasury shares directly; 149 million of the treasury shares were bought under repurchase programs for cancellation. The FY2025 20-F cover (3,341,581,714 issued including 249,882,523 treasury shares at December 31, 2025) is older.
